notes.title: System Update Deployed — RECALL NEWS DEMO
notes.content:
[p]Command has greenlit another overhaul. If you thought you knew how this worked — think again.[/p][p]🔧 [b]What’s changed:[/b][/p][p]• [b]Tutorial Reworked[/b] — onboarding is now smoother, faster, and more intuitive for new operatives. Less confusion, more clarity.[/p][p]• [b]AI System Rebuilt[/b] — smarter responses, more believable behavior, and a few… surprises. Don’t assume you’re alone.[/p][p]• [b]Sound Design Enhanced[/b] — ambient layers and effects have been refined. The silence isn’t what it used to be.[/p][p]• [b]Bugs Fixed[/b] — dozens of glitches, visual hiccups, and logic errors eliminated. The system is cleaner, but not necessarily safer.[/p][p]This version learns faster. Teaches harder.
Enter again — and pay attention this time.[/p][p]📡 Stay in signal. Stay alert.

notes.title: RECALL NEWS DEMO — SIGNAL UPDATE #2
notes.content:
[p]The zone has shifted again. Behaviors are evolving. Protocols have been patched.[/p][p]A new update is live for the RECALL NEWS DEMO, bringing refinements to your field experience, improvements under the hood, and one small briefing that might help you survive a little longer.[/p][hr][/hr][p]What’s new:[/p][p]• Monster AI adjustments — improved movement, pathing, and reactions (they're more curious now — and faster)
• Performance optimizations — smoother experience across all configurations
• Bug fixes — several reported issues neutralized
• New onboarding tutorial — a brief intro to help first-time operatives grasp the basics before they’re dropped in[/p][hr][/hr][p]Command continues to monitor your progress. Your survival helps us improve the system.
Report in. Re-enter. Try not to be seen.[/p][p]Download the update and continue the test.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3825030/Recall_News_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 🛠 RECALL NEWS DEMO — UPDATE TRANSMITTED

You haven’t.[/p][p]🔧 What’s changed:[/p][p]• Performance Optimized — smoother transitions, faster loads, reduced stutter in high-glitch areas[/p][p]• New Content Added — fresh environmental details and objects to uncover (and question)[/p][p]• UI Improved — clearer prompts, updated icons, and better flow for first-time operatives[/p][p]This is still only a glimpse — but now it flickers just a little cleaner.[/p][p]Return to the test zone. notes.title: 📡 RECALL NEWS DEMO — THE TRANSMISSION IS LIVE
notes.content: [p]The signal’s coming through. The connection is unstable. You’re in.[/p][p]The RECALL NEWS DEMO is now available on Steam.[/p][p]Enter a fractured test zone — a sliver of the full experience — where rooms bend, voices blur, and the strange becomes routine. Your assignment: investigate, collect, and report. That’s all you’ve been told.[/p][p]This is not a full deployment. It's a glimpse. A field test. A chance to prove you're operational.[/p][p] 🧭 What’s waiting for you:[/p][p]• A standalone zone, rich with anomalies and secrets[/p][p]• Suspicious objects ready to be collected and… monetized[/p][p]• Spatial uncertainty and shifting geometry[/p][p]• A strong emphasis on sound, movement, and communication[/p][p]• Moments of stillness, moments of panic, and everything between[/p][p]You’ll work with limited resources and incomplete instructions. You’ll hear voices. Some will help. Some won’t.[/p][p]Command is watching. Probably.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3825030/Recall_News_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
